description: Master airframe structural component flight-usage and fatigue tracking ledger for UK F-35 Lightning II aircraft operating at RAF Marham and deployed naval carrier strike groups. Records accumulated component flight hours against mandated structural life limits to support predictive maintenance and tail-swaps.

fields.name: telemetry_record_id
fields.description: Primary Key (PK): Unique post-flight sensor upload and usage record identifier (e.g., TEL-ZM151-ACT-99812 or TEL-20261102-0941).

fields.name: tail_number
fields.description: Cluster Key: UK military aircraft registration tail identifier (e.g., ZM151, ZM154) operating under RAF 617 Sqn, 207 Sqn, or 809 NAS.

fields.name: aircraft_variant
fields.description: Valid enum values: 'F-35A' (Conventional Take-Off and Landing) or 'F-35B' (Short Take-Off and Vertical Landing STOVL).

fields.name: base_location
fields.description: Current operating station or carrier deployment base: 'RAF Marham', 'HMS Queen Elizabeth', or 'HMS Prince of Wales'. 'RAF Marham' (land-based Main Operating Base / MOB) and 'HMS Queen Elizabeth' / 'HMS Prince of Wales' (afloat carrier platforms) together form the UK Carrier Strike Group (CSG) / UK Lightning Force force-generation enterprise; queries for 'Carrier Strike Group' or 'fleet-wide' span all bases without filtering out 'RAF Marham', whereas 'afloat'/'embarked' maps to ('HMS Queen Elizabeth', 'HMS Prince of Wales') and 'ashore'/'MOB' maps to 'RAF Marham'.

fields.name: part_serial_number
fields.description: Cluster Key: Manufacturer serialized component tracking number (e.g., ACT-99812-F for horizontal tail / port electro-hydrostatic actuators).

fields.name: nsn
fields.description: Foreign Key (FK -> global_depot_inventory.nsn): 13-digit NATO Stock Number (e.g., 1680-01-619-4821) referencing global logistics depot records.

fields.name: component_name
fields.description: Human-readable aircraft subsystem component nomenclature (e.g., Port Electro-Hydrostatic Actuator (EHA) / Left Horizontal Tail Actuator).

fields.name: current_flight_hours
fields.description: Unit: flight hours (hrs). Total accumulated flight hours logged on this specific component post-mission (e.g., 1000.4 hrs).

fields.name: life_limit_threshold_hrs
fields.description: Unit: flight hours (hrs). Mandatory safety condemnation limit in flight hours (e.g., 1000.0 hrs). Any component exceeding this limit forces aircraft status to PMC-M (Partial Mission Capable - Maintenance Required).
